content.comment_body: Hello, thank you, I'm beginning to understand how it works. Is there also an option to display the numbers you enter on the [product_name] calendar? Or any way to get feedback—when you input a value, it says "submitted," but the current value isn't visible.

I'm not sure I understand your question. What do you mean by "[product_name] calendar"? If you change a value in an analog input field and see "submitted," that means the input was accepted. The new value will be shown once you leave the input field.

Hello, after entering a number, the web server replaces it with '16#'. I notice the entered number (such as 12:08) is sent to the controller, but I would like to see this value displayed directly on the web server.
Refer to this topic: How can the hex marking ('16#') be removed when showing switch times for a weekly timer in the extended web server?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering a problem with input visibility on the [product_name] Web Editor calendar. After submitting a value, it is replaced by a '16#' indicator and isn't visible, making it unclear whether the value was accepted. This causes confusion, as users want better and more immediate confirmation when entering values.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect instant visual feedback for entered values and confirmation that the value is stored and currently set, all available through the web interface.
